messages.subject: Mediation/Moderated-Mediation Plots - formatting
parts:
Hi all

Just wondering if anyone knows how to format mediation/moderated-mediation plots in Lavaan? I'm trying to mark out standardized coefficients in bold font or by adding stars. The code I'm using adds additional variables with estimates and stars rather than adding the stars to the existing estimates:

# Function to add stars for significance levels
add_sig_stars <- function(estimates, pvals) {
  sapply(seq_along(estimates), function(i) {
    stars <- if (pvals[i] < 0.001) "***" else if (pvals[i] < 0.01) "**" else if (pvals[i] < 0.05) "*" else ""
    paste0(round(estimates[i], 2), stars)
  })
}

# Extract coefficients and p-values from model
estimates <- lavaan::standardizedSolution(fit.1)$est.std  # Standardized estimates
pvals <- lavaan::standardizedSolution(fit.1)$pvalue       # Corresponding p-values

# Add stars to coefficients
# Function to add stars based on p-values, handling NA values
add_sig_stars <- function(estimates, pvals) {
  sapply(seq_along(estimates), function(i) {
    if (is.na(pvals[i])) {
      return(paste0(round(estimates[i], 2)))  # If p-value is NA, just return the estimate
    } else {
      stars <- if (pvals[i] < 0.001) "***" else if (pvals[i] < 0.01) "**" else if (pvals[i] < 0.05) "*" else ""
      paste0(round(estimates[i], 2), stars)
    }
  })
}

# Create the plot
lavaanPlot(
  model = fit.1,
  labels = labels_with_stars, # Append stars directly to labels
  node_options = list(shape = "box", fontname = "Helvetica"),
  edge_options = list(color = "grey"),
  coefs = TRUE, # Turn off default coefficient display
  stand = TRUE
)

print(lavaanPlot(model = fit.1, node_options = list(shape = "box", fontname = "Helvetica"), edge_options = list(color = "grey"), coefs = TRUE, stand = TRUE))

Would be grateful for any tips on this!

Many thanks,
Janine
